evidence: Down the middle column: a top band of about 7 rows with props sitting on it, then a 2-row light edge line (rows 12-13), then a dark shadow band (rows 14-15). Below that is the front face (rows 16-29) with drawers drawn inset with dark inner edges and a dark base plinth. style.evidence: The outline is a dark brown tinted to the wood, which is good. The ramps are shallow, with about 4 steps: orange top, light edge, mid brown drawers and dark brown frame. The drawer insets and the top are large flat single-colour areas of 8x5 px or more, with no grain, wood speckle or per-element shading. The reference stall and well carry more texture and more colours per tile, so the candidate looks flatter than the reference.
